title: Correct correlation-only structured-event persistence shape

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Structured-event correlation persistence tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/diagnostics/test_server_events.py

evidence_required: .protocols/FT-009/clarification.md#finding--correlation-only-persistence-shape RED: the pre-correction migration 0018 baseline plus matching ORM/envelope validation reject a synthetic qr.session_expired event with null attempt_id and present correlation_id; GREEN: one next-linear Alembic correction and matching diagnostics ORM/envelope rules persist and reload that exact correlation-only row while preserving the accepted both-identities and uncorrelated shapes; decisive comparison: disposable predecessor/upgrade/downgrade schema transitions, direct repository/envelope writes and retained baseline rows with the new-shape fixture removed before downgrade; artifact: redacted correlation-only migration/runtime evidence under .tasks/TASK-095-T3-FT-009-W1/.
purpose: Repair the diagnostics-owned persistence provider so the already accepted correlation-only event shape is durable before the paused FT-009 search task resumes.
success_outcome: A correlation-only structured server event is accepted consistently by the diagnostics envelope, ORM metadata and PostgreSQL constraint through one linear data-preserving migration, without changing the event catalog or any participant behavior.
anti_goals: Do not implement or modify the TASK-091 search page, filters, authorization, HTML projection or FT-008 navigation.
Do not rewrite migration 0018, change the fixed event catalog/envelope fields, invent an Attempt association or alter producer/retention behavior.
Do not change canonical specs, feature acceptance, module topology, Foundation, Planning Revision or production data/configuration.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL rows, production migration execution and operator/default server-event data
TASK-091 staff search/UI implementation, FT-008 routes, Promo Attempt/session writes and direct diagnostics reads of promo tables
Event catalog/field expansion, producer/retention behavior, canonical specifications, Foundation and Global Planning Revision
stop_conditions: The correction cannot remain a next-linear diagnostics-owned migration plus matching local validator change.
A correlation-only row would require an invented Attempt association, a promo-table read, an event-envelope/catalog change or another architecture edge.
Upgrade/downgrade and regression proof cannot use a disposable database with known baseline rows, safe rerun, explicit fixture cleanup and redacted artifacts.
Executing the repair would require replaying, verifying or disposing TASK-091 before this prerequisite is closed.

constraints: Primary owner and code root are diagnostics at src/face_moment/diagnostics/; only its persistence constraint, matching envelope validation and focused regression proof change.
Create a new linear Alembic correction after the actual current predecessor; leave migration 0018 immutable and keep one head, one Base/MetaData and one application schema.

Feature migration proof is limited to the correction revision, its direct down_revision, predecessor-to-revision upgrade, downgrade after removing the new-shape fixture, schema transition and preservation of pre-existing accepted rows; it must not require this revision to remain the mutable repository head.
Admit the required null attempt_id plus present correlation_id shape without inventing an Attempt, and keep the existing both-identities and truthfully uncorrelated shapes valid.
Keep database CheckConstraint text, SQLAlchemy metadata and envelope validation behavior aligned; preserve fixed fields, catalog, indexes, redaction, owner and non-blocking writer behavior.

Use only synthetic UUID/release values in a UUID-named disposable PostgreSQL database, prove known initial state and safe rerun, remove the correlation-only fixture before downgrade, force-drop the database in cleanup and retain only redacted artifacts.
invariants: Diagnostics remains the only writer and validator of face_moment.server_events; shared PostgreSQL grants no producer write authority.
A known correlation_id does not require or justify an invented attempt_id, and a persisted correlation-only row remains an immutable searchable diagnostics projection.
The correction is additive and data-preserving for existing rows; it changes no fixed event field, catalog mapping, index, retention cutoff or participant outcome.
TASK-091 remains in_progress with its Attempt 1 RED/blocker evidence intact and is not repaired, replayed, verified or dispositioned until TASK-095 is done.
verification_targets: Alembic inspection proves one linear stream, the correction's actual direct predecessor, upgrade/downgrade of only that revision and preservation of seeded accepted baseline rows without rewriting migration 0018.

A disposable PostgreSQL and repository fixture proves a qr.session_expired row with null attempt_id and present correlation_id survives commit and reload, while both-identities and uncorrelated rows remain valid.
Envelope/ORM/constraint parity tests prove the same correlation-only acceptance and reject forbidden field/catalog shapes without adding a promo lookup or invented Attempt association.
Focused regression, mypy and ownership/source inspection preserve fixed catalog/redaction, diagnostics-only persistence, non-blocking writer behavior and absence of TASK-091 search/UI changes.
